review_note: Reviewed NIDDK Symptoms & Causes of Diabetes and the supplied Endotext Pathogenesis of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus chapter. NIDDK establishes that type 2 diabetes develops when impaired insulin action is accompanied by insufficient insulin production to maintain normal blood glucose. Endotext explains that pancreatic beta-cell compensation can initially maintain normal glucose despite insulin resistance, while inadequate compensation contributes to progression toward overt diabetes. Both sources support Insulin resistance → Type 2 diabetes mellitus as a risk or contributory relationship rather than an inevitable outcome. RISK_FACTOR_FOR is appropriate. AI-assisted review; human confirmation pending.
